get.description: Reports whether the organization has a Linear credential, what kind it is, the workspace and the Linear user it belongs to, and whether a Linear OAuth app is available to install. No credential is returned.

delete.description: Removes the organization's Linear credential and its workspace, whether an API key or an installed app; for an installed app it also revokes the app's access in Linear. People's own Linear credentials are kept. Disconnecting an organization with no credential succeeds and changes nothing.

put.description: Checks a personal Linear API key against Linear, stores it as the organization's Linear credential in place of any API key it had, connects the organization to the key's workspace, and returns the connection status. A key cannot replace an installed Linear app, which is disconnected first.
put.summary: Set the organization's Linear API key

get.description: Reads, live from Linear, which of the Linear teams the organization's teams track its Linear credential can read, and returns the readable ones that are private and the ones it cannot read. Both lists are complete and unpaginated, bounded by the tracked teams.
get.summary: Get which tracked Linear teams the credential reads

delete.description: Removes the organization's own Linear OAuth app and its client secret, and returns the app status. It is refused while Triage Factory is installed in Linear with that app, and removing an app the organization does not have succeeds and changes nothing.
delete.summary: Remove the organization's Linear OAuth app

get.description: Returns which Linear OAuth app installing Triage Factory in the organization's Linear workspace runs against, the organization's own or the deployment's, and the redirect URIs to register on it. The client secret is never returned.
get.summary: Get the organization's Linear OAuth app

put.description: Stores a Linear OAuth app's client id and secret as the organization's own app, replacing any it had, and returns the app status. The credentials are stored without being checked against Linear, and an app with another client id is refused while Triage Factory is installed in Linear with the current one.
put.summary: Store the organization's Linear OAuth app

delete.description: Removes the caller's own Linear credential for the organization's workspace, and revokes it in Linear when it came from one-click Connect. Disconnecting with no credential stored succeeds and changes nothing.

get.description: Reports whether the caller has a working Linear credential stored for the organization's Linear workspace, and which account it belongs to.

post.description: Checks the caller's personal Linear API key against Linear, stores it as the caller's Linear credential in place of any they had, and returns the account it belongs to. A key from another workspace than the organization's, or one that acts as an app user, is refused.

get.description: Reads the Linear team the organization's Linear credential can see whose key is exactly the one given, matched with case, live from Linear.

parameters.description: The team's key as Linear writes it, such as ENG.
parameters.name: key

post.description: Reads one page of the Linear teams the organization's Linear credential can see, live from Linear. A page may hold fewer than page_size teams and still have a next_page_token. total_count is always null, and page_size 0 is refused, because Linear reports no total.

items.description: The rows of this page, as an empty array when it has none.

next_page_token.description: The page_token that reads the next page, absent on the last page.

total_count.description: How many rows match the request's filters across every page, or null for a list whose upstream cannot count them.

get.description: Returns the organization's LLM spend over the window, in USD, with its totals by team, person, category, model, and UTC day, and the spend attributed to no team.

parameters.description: End of the window, exclusive, as an RFC 3339 timestamp or a YYYY-MM-DD date read as UTC midnight, which must be after since when both are given.
